name: Music Video Release
tagline: Turns your track and lyrics into a timed shot list and a prompt board
description: Give it the MP3, the lyrics and the visual lane you want, and it plans the video: a brief, a structure, a timed shot list, a copy-paste prompt board, a stitch order and a release checklist. It never invents lyrics, does not generate the footage, and uploads nothing - publishing stays yours.
author: Joseph
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
